parts.reasoning: The object is a simple fabric placemat. As a rigid body approximation in Isaac Sim, it will be modeled as a thin, lightweight box or convex hull. The material is fabric, so the density will be relatively low (around 300-500 kg/m^3 for tightly woven cotton/linen), and the mass will be very small, likely under 0.1 kg. Friction will be moderate to high depending on the surface it rests on, but we will assign typical fabric values (static ~0.6, dynamic ~0.5). Restitution will be near zero as fabric does not bounce. A bounding_cube or convex_hull collider is sufficient due to its flat, simple shape.
